_meta.zeroIsAClaim: A rule returning ZERO findings on the live tree is a claim requiring evidence, not a pass (Bean-locked, 2026-08-03, after coordinator review caught rule 01 counting <InspectorControls> elements instead of panels and silently missing 42+ real unrouted blocks — including hero, the specific block flagged as unusable). Whoever adds a rule MUST: (1) state its expected population BEFORE trusting a live run, using a method independent of the rule's own code — a second script in a different style, a manual grep, or a hand count; (2) if the rule returns 0 or a suspiciously round/small number, treat that as a red flag and re-derive the condition from what the checklist item actually requires, not from what was easy to detect in one file; (3) record the comparison (expected vs actual) somewhere reviewable before setting the rule's advisoryReason. All three shipped rules here (01/18/20) were cross-checked this way on 2026-08-03: 01 measured 65 (was silently 0 under the first, wrong condition), 18 measured 15 (was 12 before a shared-component blind spot — MediaPicker.js — was found and fixed), 20 measured 23 (was 43 before a wrong exclusion mechanism — filename prefix instead of the pattern's own 'Post Types:' header — was found and fixed).

rules.advisoryReason: GENUINELY NEW detector — the exact complement of check-dead-controls.js CHECK 4 (which fires only when there is no control AND NO render, so the whole of this quadrant is invisible to it by construction). Measured live 2026-08-08: 280 findings across 35 of 83 blocks. ⚠ READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING 53: the contract's '53' is NOT a census of the quadrant — it is the SUM OF FOUR AUDITED FAMILIES (hover 31 / typography tiers 10 / physics-canvas box 8 / heading+text boxShadow 4), which the contract itself confirms at §5 field 6 (physics-canvas 'declares 6 responsive box attrs, passes them to SGS_Container_Wrapper, which renders them — and its edit.js contains "padding" zero times' — i.e. only its BOX subset was counted, not its 79 unreachable container attrs). 53 is therefore a FLOOR, and the acceptance test is CONTAINMENT, not equality. Containment verified family by family: typography tiers 10/10 EXACT (button 4 + brand-strip 4 + text 2 — and text's lineHeight tiers are correctly NOT flagged, reproducing the contract's own '10, not 12' correction, because text already has working line-height tier controls at edit.js:352-353); heading/text boxShadow 4/4 EXACT; *Hover-with-no-control 8 blocks EXACT against §6 field 3's per-attribute audit ('8 blocks, ~27 attrs' — note line 116 instructs using the per-attribute audit, NOT the '9 blocks' summary row), 33 attrs vs that approximate ~27, with §6 field 5's named false-positive trap team-member.overlayHover ('a behavioural flag, not a state pair') present in the 33 and owed triage; physics-canvas box attrs found inside its 79. Both documented traps are CLOSED and fixture-proven: TRAP A (brand-strip) yields exactly nameLineHeightTablet/Mobile + nameLetterSpacingTablet/Mobile, names that appear literally in NO file and are recoverable only through the $prefix . 'LineHeightTablet' shape at includes/helpers-typography.php:90,91,98,99; TRAP B (fontSizeTablet, built by computed key at src/components/TypographyControls.js:144) does NOT false-positive. Three corrections were forced by measurement during the build, each recorded in the rule header with its cause: 826 -> 611 (shared components also live in BLOCK-LOCAL dirs, e.g. src/blocks/container/components/ContainerWrapperControls.js) -> 284 (that 57KB file also EXPORTS the individual panels LayoutPanel/WidthPanel/etc., which is what blocks actually render) -> 280 (a class file must be invoked as a class, not admitted by a bare `render(` call that 34 of 84 blocks match). NOT promotable: 280 is a large real backlog, and the residual >53 is a mix of genuinely-in-quadrant-but-unaudited attrs (physics-canvas's 79 are hand-confirmed real — its edit.js was read IN FULL and exposes exactly three controls: physicsGravity, physicsBounce, physicsEdgeResistance) and any remaining false positives that per-block triage has not yet separated. Do NOT cite 280 as 'the fourth quadrant is 280' until that triage exists. ✅ THAT TRIAGE NOW EXISTS (2026-08-08). All 280 were classified from a per-finding evidence table (which render file matched, and by what mechanism: literal name / dynamic suffix / dynamic prefix / comment-only). FOUR false-positive CLASSES were found. ONE was fixed IN THIS RULE rather than baselined, because it is a WordPress contract recurring on every block, not a per-case exception: 6 findings whose control is rendered by WordPress CORE from the block's own supports (anchor / align / color.background / color.text / typography.textAlign). Core renders those in the Advanced panel, the alignment toolbar and the Colour panel — none of which lives in edit.js or any SGS shared component, so this rule's two corpora could never see them. That is a SECOND structurally-invisible control surface, sibling to the extension surface documented above and NOT covered by it. See coreSupportedAttrs() plus its fixture PAIR: core-supports-provided-control (mustNotFlag) and the positive twin core-supports-absent-still-flags (mustFlag — the same defect shape with supports removed), so the exclusion is provably able to fail rather than being an unconditional name skip. The other THREE classes are baselined with per-entry checkable reasons, each left unfixed deliberately because the fix would touch machinery shared with other rules and silently restage their committed backlogs: comment-only matches (3 — core/sources.js:151-156 strips only slash-star comments from PHP and CSS, so a double-slash line comment survives into the render corpus; all three are comments stating the attribute is deliberately NOT read); variable-tail key construction (8 — before-after/edit.js:241-245 builds its tier keys with a literal fragment BETWEEN two interpolations, which no SUFFIX_SHAPE can reach since all four require a literal tail); and one prose collision (testimonial-slider.testimonials matches the English word inside aria-label strings). SURVIVING REAL POPULATION: 262 FLAGGED across 32 of 83 blocks (280 minus 6 by the rule fix = 274, minus 12 BASELINED = 262). STILL NOT PROMOTABLE — 262 is a large real backlog, and a smaller number was never the goal. The dominant real family is NOT in the audited 53: a block that passes its whole attributes array to SGS_Container_Wrapper::render() inherits the wrapper's entire attribute vocabulary as rendered, so every container/grid/background attr it declares without a control is frozen at its block.json default forever (physics-canvas 79, nav-menu 17, site-header-row 12, site-footer-row 12). Verified, not assumed: nav-menu/render.php:1436 passes the attributes wholesale and nav-menu/edit.js mentions none of its 17. ⚠ The handoff-predicted false positive team-member.overlayHover DID NOT MATERIALISE — that block's four findings are all hover values (scaleHover / shadowHover / imageZoomHover / grayscaleHover) and overlayHover is not among them.
